oc_i2c#4|master_transactions_interrupts_:
await self.tick(4)
        status = await self.read(4)
        assert status & 3 == 1

await self.tick(40)  # BUSY clears a few clocks after IF
        status = await self.read(4)
        assert status & 3 == 1

assert status & 0xA2 == 0
    assert status & 0x22 == 0  # probe: RxACK not checked
